results.title: Vertex reports strong CASGEVY launch metrics; new patient starts accelerate
results.description: Vertex Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: VRTX) reported accelerating new patient starts for CASGEVY this quarter, with authorized treatment centers expanding. Gross-to-net was stable and channel inventory normalized.

results.title: Moderna respiratory franchise faces 2026 guidance scrutiny ahead of contract season
results.description: Moderna (NASDAQ: MRNA) faces investor scrutiny over 2026 respiratory revenue guidance as contracting season approaches. Analysts flag formulary positioning risk.
